title: Personal Loans Servicing Standard: Charging a Late Fee and the Late Fee Tool
content:
## Rule

A late fee is charged on an installment of an active Personal Loans loan that is still not paid in full when its grace period ends, at most one per installment, and is assessed on the oldest unpaid installment (the loan's next due date) once the current date is later than that due date plus the late-fee grace period; no late fee is charged for an installment inside an active hardship plan, for a deferred installment or while a Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit is active. The amount is worked out under the Personal Loans late-fee figuring for the loan's state fee schedule.

A late fee that works out to 0.00 is not charged: no late-fee line is written for that installment, and it is not counted as a late fee charged on the loan.

| Fact on the records | Late fee charged |
|---|---|
| loan active, oldest unpaid installment past its grace period, no late fee yet for it | yes, if the fee works out above 0.00 |
| a late fee already charged for that installment | no |
| installment inside an active hardship plan, or deferred | no |
| Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit active | no |
| fee works out to 0.00 | no line written |

## The late fee tool

**What it does.** `assess_late_fee_8eb98004` records one late fee line on a Personal Loans loan, dated today, for the installment named by its due date, under the named state fee schedule, and adds the fee to the loan's unpaid fees. Nothing else on the loan changes. Once recorded, the fee appears in the loan's ledger and the loan's unpaid fees are higher by the fee amount.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `assess_late_fee_8eb98004` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `loan_id` | reference number of the personal loan charged, as returned by the loan lookup |
| `customer_id` | reference number of the borrower who owns that loan, as returned by the customer profile lookup |
| `installment_due_date` | due date of the installment the fee is charged for, YYYY-MM-DD; no empty value |
| `fee_schedule` | state fee schedule the fee is charged under, exactly one of `schedule_a` (the loan's origination state uses fee schedule A), `schedule_b` (fee schedule B), `schedule_c` (fee schedule C) |
| `amount` | the late fee in USD, a decimal number with 2 decimal places; stored rounded to the cent |

**Return.** A one-line confirmation of the form "Late fee <ledger line id> charged on loan <loan id> for the installment due <YYYY-MM-DD>: <USD with 2 decimals> under <schedule>; unpaid fees now <USD with 2 decimals>." The ledger line id is the reference number of the new fee; its presence means the fee was recorded.
